# deps: tools: cleanup go binaries before install it from updates

Empty the Go binary directory before `self-update tools` reinstalls the toolset. **Motivation:** "prevent garbage growth" — tools removed from [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) (looppointer, gotest, panicparse, fzf, …) stayed in `~/go/bin` forever, since `go install` only adds.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/386#issuecomment-5711703286
Code vs intent: `clean_tools` does `rm -rf ~/go/bin/*` — it wipes every binary in GOBIN, including ones installed outside the toolset (a local `maintainer` build, `go install`ed one-offs), not only stale toolset tools. `.github/reviews/20260710T095546Z.md` finding 5. A targeted removal (only names that `tools.go` used to produce) is what the ticket asked for.
